feedTitle: Isle of Man 5 day weather forecast

items.title: 5 day forecast updated as of 24 September 2026 4:17am
items.description:
##Today##

Mainly dry with variable amounts of cloud as well as hazy sunshine breaking through at times. Occasional rain or drizzle then arriving overnight into Friday.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 6°C and max. air temperature 17°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

1-4


##Wind Speed##

17


##Wind Direction##

S


##Wind##

S or SE 5-15, veering S 15-20 through the morning, increasing 20-25 later in the afternoon and evening, veering W 5-15 overnight into Friday.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate or poor in rain or drizzle. Hill fog for a time overnight.


##Comments##

Strong winds for a time.


##Tomorrow##

Cloudy with outbreaks of rain to start, this clearing through the morning with bright or sunny intervals developing in the afternoon.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 11°C and max. air temperature 16°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

1-3


##Wind Speed##

12


##Wind Direction##

SW


##Wind##

W 5-15, quickly backing SW 10-15, increasing 15-20 in the evening and occasionally 25 later.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in rain. Isolated hill fog patches at first.


##Comments##

Occasional strong winds later.
